segments.text: Set it up once. After that, the job moves itself.
A job comes in and becomes a record. Client, site, cause, scope of loss.
Your technician opens it on site. The record tells them what to capture, and files what they capture where it belongs.
Scoping builds from what was recorded. The estimate builds from the scope.
Documentation assembles from the same evidence, rather than from somebody's recollection a week later.
The client sees progress without ringing you. The invoice draws from the approved scope. Reconciliation matches what was billed against what was done.
Nobody retypes anything. Each stage inherits the one before it.
Set up one job type properly, then watch the next ten follow it.
